caseSYNTH001.description: Synthetic, unpacked Threema for Android data backup with entirely fabricated values, generated by admin/test/scripts/gen_threema_android_synth.py. No real backup data: a backup is one person's complete chat history. CSV headers, file names and the JSON layout of message bodies follow a real Threema for Android backup. Covers a backup folder carrying Threema's own name in the older column layout of the real backup, and a second one that lost the name (separate conversations, blank Account ID) in the column layout of the current Threema source, with a starred, an edited and a deleted message, group message states, call statuses flagged as status messages and a GROUP_STATUS; a decoy folder whose contacts.csv and message_*.csv have another layout (adds nothing), the CSV writer's doubled backslashes in JSON bodies (one invalid JSON, one literal backslash-n), a voice message stored as ISO-BMFF with only a sound track (typed audio), a video, an IMAGE message without media, a quote, a location, a call status, a contact with an empty chat file, a group with a status message and a member missing from contacts.csv, profile picture and avatar files, and an orphaned media file and thumbnail.
